title: Sara Bensalem 100-Point Spatial Portfolio Audit Rubric (2026 Enhanced Edition)
author: Sara Bensalem <sara@sarabensalem.com>

criteria.desc: Project Passport clarity: explicitly stating typology, gross area, location, software stack, and line-item individual attribution (preventing the 'Mystery Role' red flag).
5-Act spatial case study structure (Hook -> Context/Constraints -> Spatial Anatomy -> Tectonic Proof -> Lived Climax) or sequential graphic novel framing.
Scannable typography hierarchy (Space Grotesk display, Inter body, JetBrains Mono metadata) structured for 15s/30s recruiter triage.
Clear articulation of real constraints (soil salinity, urban density, tight budgets, seismic/flood risk) and verifiable architectural resolution.
Scaled architectural orthographics (1:100 to 1:20) with hierarchy of lineweights (cut profiles 0.50mm, secondary assemblies 0.25mm, hairlines 0.13mm).
Layered 1:20 constructive wall sections specifying waterproofing membranes, insulation lambda values, U-value calculation, and continuous structural thermal breaks.
Legible closed dimension strings, structural column grids, level datum lines (FFL/TOS), and graphic scale bars.
Demonstrated universal accessibility (1500mm PMR/ADA wheelchair turning circles, 900mm door arcs) and IBC emergency egress compliance.
Rigorous multi-column grid discipline (8, 12, or 16 columns) with synchronized horizontal baseline rhythm across all spreads.
Restrained typographic palette (maximum 2 typeface families, 3 standardized scale tiers), avoiding font chaos.
Generous negative space (35-50% breathing room, such as the 50% left text margin rule) preventing visual claustrophobia.
Dynamic visual rhythm alternating between macro contextual overviews and high-density technical plate sets.
Macro scale (1:500 - 1:1000): Topographical contours, hydrological bioswales, transit connectivity, or urban morphology block typologies.
Meso scale (1:100 - 1:50): Comprehensive floor plans, circulation spines, spatial sequencing, and programmatic zoning.
Micro scale (1:20 - 1:5): Demountable pin joints, custom cabinetry reveals (joint creux), concealed hardware pockets, or 1:1 material prototypes.
Environmental performance proof: Solar altitude vectors, natural ventilation stack loops, or Ladybug/Honeybee radiation heatmaps and thermal comfort metrics.
Diurnal study: Paired day/night elevations or daylight factor simulation demonstrating both daylight control and nocturnal social activation.
Material-grounded color harmony derived from authentic construction geology (terracotta, stone, timber, steel) rather than saturated digital gradients.
Optimized PDF binary (< 50 MB) ensuring rapid loading across email and web screening passes.
Documented construction validation (on-site supervision logs, built freelance commissions, competition awards, or tier-1 consultant internships).
Direct running contact footer (email, phone, mobility rights), software competency badges, and clear career intent.
